summary: Round-2 fixes are documentation-only (clampKeyboardLabels doc comment) plus 4 additive IT cases; no production logic changed. Both round-1 minor findings are adequately resolved by accurately documenting the intentional null-vs-empty contract, and the new tests each pin a real behavioral contract whose assertions match the actual code. No new issues introduced; FunnelControllerIT (including all 4 new cases) is green.

round1FollowUp.finding: clampKeyboardLabels empty-input → [] vs null inconsistency (round-1 minor)
round1FollowUp.resolution: Resolved (documentation). Doc comment now states the contract precisely: null input → null ("author typed no rows"); non-null input is echoed as a clamped structure even when it flattens to empty, because preview faithfully mirrors in-progress form state and the SET_KEYBOARD discriminator (keyboardRows null-vs-present) is load-bearing for the frontend. Comment matches code: `if (rows == null) return null;` then always builds/returns `out`. Behavior intentionally unchanged.

round1FollowUp.finding: Empty inner row when all buttons skipped (round-1 minor)
round1FollowUp.resolution: Resolved (documentation). Same rationale now documented ("a row whose buttons all dropped → an empty inner []"). Code confirms a non-null row with all-null/blank buttons produces an empty `labels` list that is still added via `out.add(labels)`. Accurate.

newChangesAssessment.docComment: clampKeyboardLabels doc comment expanded with null-vs-empty contract. Accurate against implementation; no behavioral drift.

newTests.note: Asserts <script>alert(1)</script> for parseMode=HTML. Verified against VariableTemplateRenderer: only substituted values are escaped (escapeHtml on the resolved firstName), literal template tags pass through. Plus a defense-in-depth body.doesNotContain("

3-arg previewKeyboardBody(...) resolves via varargs to zero rows → keyboardRows omitted from body → request.keyboardRows() null → clampKeyboardLabels returns null → $.keyboardRows absent. Null keyboardText renders to "" (renderer null-tolerant). Matches code.

No linked owner → resolveOwnerSubscriber empty → stubSubscriber() with firstName "Іван" (verified line 579), sampleData=true. Asserts "Привіт Іван" + sampleData=true. Correct, mirrors message-branch stub fallback.
Pins the off-by-one boundary: MAX_KEYBOARD_BUTTON_TEXT=64 and clamp uses strict `>` (text.length() > MAX), so a 64-char label is echoed untruncated. Asserts exactly64 round-trips. Correct.
